message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming CSV or pkl data; data is loaded and used directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data files are loaded from local paths and BertTokenizer is loaded via from_pretrained without any checksum verification, pinned revision, or authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained BERT weights via `BertTokenizer.from_pretrained(cfg.lm_file)` and loads serialized pickle files without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any custom adversarial perturbation logic anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although separate train/valid/test splits are loaded, the test set is not clearly isolated (test_dataloader is created but never used in the visible evaluation loop), there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and only a single F1 metric is tracked without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: The collate_fn pads and tensorizes inputs but performs no shape/range validation or schema checks on incoming data before passing it to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation are applied to model outputs anywhere in the inference/validation path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: Although a BERT-based LM model is supported, the code contains no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation.
